The ERC error comes from Mp2's width, about 5.7 mm. That device carries I2 = 5 mA/(50·2) = 50 µA at gm/Id = 18 with L = 0.3 µm. At that gm/Id it sits in deep weak inversion, so the width balloons. I'm lowering Mp2's gm/Id (range 7–13) and splitting it into fingers so per-device W stays legal; the 50 µA load-step drive is unchanged. I'm doing the same finger split for the large diode Md. Nothing else changes.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "ERC failure: Mp2 width 5673 um exceeds 5000 um limit (50 uA at gm/Id 18, L 0.3). Lower Mp2 gm/Id range to 7-13 and split Mp2 and Md into fingers so per-device width stays legal. Topology and compensation unchanged."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_pass": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),     # pass device gm/Id at max load (dropout at 1.62 V)
    "L_pass":    (0.18, 0.15, 0.3),
    "N":         (50, 25, 100),         # pass : diode mirror ratio
    "I_tail":    (20e-6, 10e-6, 28e-6), # OTA tail current
    "G":         (5.0, 3.0, 9.0),       # mid-band A_ea*beta_hf
    "wz_ratio":  (8.0, 4.0, 16.0),      # wu_low / wz
    "Rdeg":      (2e3, 0.5e3, 6e3),     # Mp2 source degeneration
    "Cff":       (1e-12, 0.3e-12, 4e-12),
    "vshift":    (0.35, 0.25, 0.42),    # total pair common-mode shift above vref
    "gmid_p2":   (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),     # Mp2 gm/Id at max load (moderate inversion -> sane W)
    "Cgc":       (2e-12, 0.5e-12, 6e-12),  # vout -> pass gate coupling cap
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6); vo = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2); cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)
    ilmax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3); ilmin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    N = int(round(p["N"])); k = 2
    Idiv = 6e-6; Is = 2e-6; It = p["I_tail"]; L1 = 1.0; L3 = 0.5; Lp = p["L_pass"]
    Rdeg = p["Rdeg"]; Cff = p["Cff"]; G = p["G"]; Cgc = p["Cgc"]

    Rbot = vref / Idiv; Rtop = (vo - vref) / Idiv
    Rth = Rtop * Rbot / (Rtop + Rbot)
    Rs = max(10e3, p["vshift"] / Is - Rth)

    mb = lut.size("n", 15, 1.0, iref, vds=0.5)
    Wb = mb.W; Wt = Wb * It / iref; Wbp = Wb * Is / iref
    mpb = lut.size("p", 10, 1.0, Is, vds=0.7)

    m1 = lut.size("n", 20, L1, It / 2, vds=0.3, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 14, L3, It / 2, vds=0.9)
    gm1 = m1.gm; A0 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)

    I2 = ilmax / (N * k)
    mp2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p2"], 0.3, I2, vds=0.5)
    mny = lut.size("n", 10, 0.3, I2, vds=0.6)
    mpass = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], Lp, ilmax, vds=0.4)
    Wd = mpass.W / N

    Cp = 0.15e-12
    beta_hf = Cff / (Cff + Cp)
    Amid = G / beta_hf
    Rz = Amid / gm1
    Ipmin = ilmin + Idiv
    Gm_low = Ipmin * 22.0
    wu_low = 0.75 * G * Gm_low / cl
    wz = wu_low / p["wz_ratio"]
    Cz = 1.0 / (wz * Rz)

    gmp2_eff = mp2.gm / (1 + mp2.gm * Rdeg)
    Gm_high = gmp2_eff * k * N
    wu_high = G * Gm_high / cl
    Cg = mpass.cgg * (1 + 1.0 / N) + Cgc
    pg_high = (mpass.gm / N) / Cg
    pg_low = (Ipmin / N * 24.0) / Cg
    Cx = mp2.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + 20e-15
    px = 1.0 / (Rz * Cx)
    deg = lambda a: a * 180 / PI
    pm_high = 90 - deg(math.atan(wu_high / pg_high)) - deg(math.atan(wu_high / px))
    pm_low = 90 - deg(math.atan(wu_low / pg_low)) - deg(math.atan(wz / wu_low))

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.M("Mb0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb, 1.0)
    n.M("Mt", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, 1.0)
    n.M("Mbp", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wbp, 1.0)
    n.M("Mpb", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", mpb.W, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms1", "na", "pb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", mpb.W, 1.0)
    n.M("Ms2", "nb", "pb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", mpb.W, 1.0)
    n.R("Ra", "vref", "na", Rs + Rth); n.C("Ca", "na", "vss", 2e-12)
    n.R("Rs", "tap", "nb", Rs); n.C("Cs", "tap", "nb", 2e-12)
    n.R("Rtop", "vout", "tap", Rtop); n.R("Rbot", "tap", "vss", Rbot)
    n.C("Cff", "vout", "tap", Cff)
    n.M("M1", "d1", "nb", "tail", "vss", "nfet", m1.W, L1)
    n.M("M2", "x", "na", "tail", "vss", "nfet", m1.W, L1)
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vin", "vin", "pfet", m3.W, L3)
    n.M("M4", "x", "d1", "vin", "vin", "pfet", m3.W, L3)
    n.R("Rz", "x", "z", Rz); n.C("Cz", "z", "vin", Cz)
    n.R("Rdeg", "vin", "sp2", Rdeg)
    mf2 = int(max(1, math.ceil(mp2.W / 200.0)))
    n.dev("Mp2", "y", "x", "sp2", "sp2", mp2, m=mf2)
    n.M("Mny", "y", "y", "vss", "vss", "nfet", mny.W, 0.3)
    n.M("Mn", "g", "y", "vss", "vss", "nfet", k * mny.W, 0.3)
    mfd = int(max(1, math.ceil(Wd / 100.0)))
    n.M("Md", "g", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wd, Lp, m=mfd)
    n.C("Cgc", "vout", "g", Cgc)
    mf = int(min(200, max(1, round(mpass.W / 20.0))))
    n.dev("Mpass", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mpass, m=mf)

    T0_high = A0 * 0.5 * Gm_high / mpass.gds
    iq = iref + It + 3 * Is + Idiv + Ipmin / N * (1 + 1.0 / k)
    load_reg = 1e3 * (0.35 / A0 / 0.5) / ilmax + 1.0 / (A0 * 0.5 * Gm_high)
    alpha = Cgc / (Cgc + mpass.cgg)
    undershoot = 0.35 / G * (1 - 0.5 * alpha) + 0.04
    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": 100 * (0.3 / A0 / 0.5) / vo + 0.1,
        "iq": iq,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "line_reg": 1e3 / T0_high,
        "psrr_1k": 20 * math.log10(T0_high),
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "overshoot": 0.05,
        "ripple_settled": 0.001,
        "pm_high_deg": pm_high, "pm_low_deg": pm_low,
        "wu_low_hz": wu_low / (2 * PI), "wu_high_hz": wu_high / (2 * PI),
        "A0_db": db(A0), "Cz_pF": Cz * 1e12, "Rz_k": Rz / 1e3, "Rs_k": Rs / 1e3,
        "Wpass_um": mpass.W, "Wp2_um": mp2.W, "vsg_pass_tt": mpass.vgs, "vsg_load_tt": m3.vgs,
    }
```
